subject: general
question: What will be the simple interest on Rs. 1450 at 9% per annum for 3 years?
solution:
**Given:**

Principal (P) = Rs. 1450

Rate of Interest (R) = 9% per annum

Time (T) = 3 years

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = (P × R × T) ÷ 100

**Calculation:**

⇒ SI = (1450 × 9 × 3) ÷ 100

⇒ SI = (1450 × 27) ÷ 100

⇒ SI = 39150 ÷ 100

⇒ SI = Rs. 391.50

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 391.50.**
